exercises.title: Session 1: Copy practice
exercises.notes: Select this session in the official Morse Code Trainer and practice its copying message types. Initial copying settings are 18 character / 6 effective WPM; follow your advisor’s adjustments.

exercises.title: Session 1: Sending practice
exercises.notes: Use this session’s sending message types as the model for your keying. Initial sending settings are 15 character / 6 effective WPM. The complete content stays in the linked official curriculum.

exercises.title: Session 11: Copy practice
exercises.notes: Select Copying and session 11 in the official Morse Code Trainer, then practice its QSO message types. Use 25 character / at least 6 effective WPM and clear extra gaps; follow your advisor’s adjustments.

exercises.title: Session 11: Sending practice
exercises.notes: Select Sending and session 11 in the official Morse Code Trainer and use its QSO messages as keying models. The late-session goal is 25 character / at least 6 effective WPM with no extra gaps. Follow your advisor’s adjustments and keep personal details in private notes.

exercises.title: Single-character spoken recognition
exercises.notes: In the official ICR tool, select CW Academy sessions 1–10 and Letters with Speech After. Recognize each character before its spoken answer; use 75% correct recognition to guide a 1–2 WPM Farnsworth increase with your advisor.
